data.title: La Sirene - Port de La Mer
data.about:
Want to live the ultimate beachfront lifestyle? Introducing La Sirene at Port de La Mer. Choose from 1 – 4 bedroom apartments and 6 BR duplexes. Wake up to amazing and mesmerising views of the Marina Plaza and the sea.

Crafted with Mediterranean architecture, these apartments have the highest finishing quality with great interiors. Come home to the sea, the beach, and the boardwalk lifestyle with cafes and amazing amenities. This is the ideal beachfront lifestyle.

• Waterfront 1, 2, 3, 4 BR apartments & 6-BR duplex
  • Seaside lifestyle with a Mediterranean Touch
  • Starting at AED 1.29 million
  • Pay 50% during construction
  • Pay 50% upon handover
  • Private Beach Access

location_tile.title: La Sirene is located within Port de La Mer in Jumeirah.
location_tile.description:
It is nestled within minutes from the majority of the city’s attractions.

  • 5 mins – La Mer
  • 10 mins – City Walk
  • 10 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 15 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 45 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
